messages:
Maya: Quick sync — continuous-batch + cache-priming sprint status. Kernel PR #4123 merged but we still need final ownership for eviction thresholds, canary rollout, and platform routing. cc @Chris @Anika :eyes:
Chris: Saw the PR, congrats. I'll own eviction thresholds. Suggest starting from `evict_after_ms=300000` -> try `120000` for hotpath experiments. I'll open a follow-up PR with heuristics.
Anika: I can take canary rollout coordination with infra. What's the desired canary ramp and rollback criteria? :thumbsup:
Maya: Proposed ramp: 5% for 2h -> 25% for 4h -> 100% if no regressions. Rollback if token-p99 increases > 20% or queueing_time > 150ms. Also watch cpu/gpu util and failure_rate.
Lucas: FYI eng-platform needs the route flag `serve.variant=continuous-batch` before we can split traffic. I'll land the route flag change today (blocks: infra PR #789).
Chris: re: thresholds — opening PR #4130 with new eviction heuristics + unit tests. Adding a small smoke test to assert no spike in p95 under baseline load. Ping me for CRs.
Anika: Also can we add a console toggle for `kv.prefetch=true` so SRE can flip without deploy? InfraBot: deploy flag feature toggle created, rollout scheduled. :white_check_mark:
InfraBot: deploy queued for canary flag flip at 1725310200 (ETA ~ 35m).
Maya: Added instrumentation/trace link: https://opstrace/reports/1725309999/trace — check p50/p95 token latencies and request_queue_time. Please add an alert on `queueing_time > 150ms`.
Chris: Picking up eviction ownership. Will update the runbook and add rollback criteria. @Maya please attach the k6 load profile you'll use.
Maya: Will attach k6 snippet in the runbook shortly. Example load command to reproduce hotpath: ```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m script.js --rps 1500
```
Anika: Thanks — I'll coordinate with customer-facing teams for anyone on Dedicated who might see the canary. Any blocked dependencies?
Lucas: One more dependency: model-quant team wants to validate 4-bit quantized variants with this kernel change. Opening ticket T-2245, estimate 2 days of validation.
Maya: Great — owners noted: eviction=Chris, canary=Anika, routing=Lucas. If anyone needs access to the canary bucket ping infra@redwood. End of thread. :shipit:
